title: Other Medicare Cover Held Alongside a Special Needs Plan, and the Service Area
content:
A Special Needs Plan is a Medicare Advantage plan with drug coverage, so it may not be held alongside an ordinary Medicare Advantage plan or a stand-alone drug plan.

## 1. The condition tested when an election is recorded

> No Medicare Advantage enrollment or stand-alone Part D enrollment is in force for the same member on the day the Special Needs Plan coverage would begin.

Before an election in the Special Needs Plans category is recorded, the condition is tested on the member's enrollment records in the Medicare Advantage Health Plans category, matched to the member the election is for, and on what those records hold rather than on the member's account of the cover they have. An enrollment standing as disenrolled, as terminated for non-payment, or as cancelled before it took effect is not in force for this purpose.

## 2. Where the member holds one of those

Where the member holds one of those, accepting this election ends it on the day before the new coverage begins, and the member is told which cover is ending.

## 3. Permanent residence in the service area

The member's permanent residence must lie in one of the counties in the package's service area, taken from the address on their profile rather than from where they say they are staying.

## 4. A member who moves away

A member who moves out of the service area is given a special election period and told the date their cover will end, rather than being left to discover it.

## 5. A Medicare Supplement policy held alongside

Holding a Medicare Supplement policy alongside a Special Needs Plan is never right: the supplement pays nothing while a Medicare Advantage plan is in force, and the member is told so before they keep paying two premiums.

## 6. Points of judgement

| What the member's Medicare Advantage Health Plans enrollment records hold | Is the condition met? |
| --- | --- |
| No Medicare Advantage or stand-alone Part D enrollment at all | Met |
| A Medicare Advantage enrollment standing as disenrolled | Met |
| A Medicare Advantage enrollment terminated for non-payment | Met |
| A Medicare Advantage enrollment cancelled before it took effect | Met |
| A Medicare Advantage enrollment otherwise in force on the day the new coverage would begin | Not met |
